# Marketing Dashboard

## Overview
This dashboard gives Template marketing leaders a view of campaign execution, team bandwidth, and lead generation performance. It supports marketing managers, campaign owners, and creative leads in catching deadline slippage, budget overruns, and low-converting campaigns.

## Key Metrics
- Total Campaigns: 96
- Active Campaigns: 15
- Tasks Due Today: 18
- Overdue Tasks: 5
- Leads Generated: 420
- Spend vs Budget: 57%

## Insights
- Paid Search and Email channels are on track; Social is trailing in spend utilization
- Team workload is concentrated on two members — redistribution recommended
- Upcoming launches are clustered in the last week of the month — staging risk
